review_level: Fresh PRIMARY screening only; not independent second review, original approval or Pass/Collect
original_unique_math: Fold the actual net about shared unit edges with face2 normal+z, face6 normal-x, face4 normal+x, face5 normal-z, face1 normal+y and face3 normal-y. Thus opposite pairs are(2,5),(6,4),(1,3). Each folded cube corner chooses exactly one face of each pair, and all2^3 choices occur. Triples and sums are (2,6,1):9,(2,4,1):7,(5,6,1):12,(5,4,1):10,(2,6,3):11,(2,4,3):9,(5,6,3):14,(5,4,3):12. This exhaustive enumeration proves maximum<=14 and the actual corner(5,6,3) attains14. The four red flat-net junctions are only(6,2,3):11,(2,4,3):9,(6,2,1):9,(2,4,1):7; their maximum11 is the predeclared wrong answer and omits seam-created corners. No minimum is requested.
native_actual_image_inspection: Personally viewed original JPG, formal PNG, old largest-face-dot candidate and r61 PNG at native768. All six numerals1..6, all square boundaries and all free edges remain readable. Exactly four allowed red points are centered on existing flat three-face hinge junctions; none is a numeral, an interior face-selection dot or a newly created geometric vertex. The dots do not conceal which incident unit edges continue.
human_semantics: The marked local junction set is a genuine input subset for comparison against all folded corners; its claimed exhaustiveness is the intended error. Each mark identifies a different true three-face junction, so no arbitrary dot or count cap is used. The question asks for the largest sum at a corner of the cube, not at a red point. Even if dots were physical ink, they do not add numbers or restrict the quantified corners; the seam corner14 remains eligible. They add no cuts, fixed partition or equality condition.

every_marker_roles.role: r61_vertex_0 at(1,1): real junction6/2/3, local sum11 and highest member of the misleading flat subset.
r61_vertex_1 at(2,1): real junction2/4/3, local sum9; completes the lower pair rather than selecting only large numbers.
r61_vertex_2 at(1,2): real junction6/2/1, local sum9, upper left member of the complete flat-junction set.
r61_vertex_3 at(2,2): real junction2/4/1, local sum7; completes that source subset irrespective of value.

limits: Primary assessment is not an independent review or a human performance study.
No original control is required or repeated; any two observations establish observed hits only, not causal gain.
Zero-call and fresh-render gates are separate and must pass before copying/testing.
